Agents:
- Agent: Orchestrator
  -- Action: Defined the problem constraints (roles, armor, spells, items) and initiated the search for class information.
  -- Observation: Noted the need for classes that tank/heal with holy spells, use fire/ice, shapeshift into bears, cast Metamorphosis, and the unobtainable item "Kilt of the Forgotten One".
  -- Thought: Determined that WebSurfer is needed to look up current WoW class abilities and item details.
  -- Result: Issued instructions to WebSurfer to search for class abilities and item armor types.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Executed web searches for "World of Warcraft 2025 classes and abilities" and "World of Warcraft Kilt of the Forgotten One armor type".
  -- Observation: Retrieved general information about WoW classes and initiated searches for specific item details.
  -- Thought: Realized more specific searches were needed to link abilities (Metamorphosis, Bear form) to specific classes.
  -- Result: Performed additional searches and summarized page content regarding class abilities.
- Agent: Coder
  -- Action: Synthesized the gathered information to propose a class list.
  -- Observation: Identified Paladin (Tank/Holy/Plate), Priest (Healer/Holy/Cloth), Druid (Bear), Mage (Fire/Ice/Cloth), and Demon Hunter (Metamorphosis).
  -- Thought: Deduced that the "Kilt of the Forgotten One" is likely Mail armor, and since the group has only Plate and Cloth wearers, no one can use it.
  -- Result: Proposed the final list: Demon Hunter, Druid, Mage, Paladin, Priest.
